textTemplates.name: Approvalemailtexttemplate
textTemplates.text:
Dear Agency Partner,

 

Your recent application for Ticketing Authority has been approved.

 

This decision was made with Qantas' sole discretion and are contingent on continued compliance with your obligations within Qantas' Standard Agency Terms and Conditions, available on the homepage of the Qantas Agency Connect site.

 

Please note: This inbox is solely used to process applications for Qantas Ticketing Authority. If your email does not include an application, it is likely you will not receive a response.

 

If you have a related general enquiry, please go to Qantas Agency Connect, or reach out to your local Qantas Representative or relevant contact point outlined below.

textTemplates.text:
Dear Agency Partner,
 
Re: Application for Qantas Ticketing Authority

Thank you for your interest in becoming an appointed ticketing agent for Qantas. After reviewing your request, we regret to inform you that your application has not been successful on this occasion. 

If you wish to discuss your application further, please contact your local Qantas Sales office.

Kind regards,

Qantas E-Ticketing Team
